test_cases:
# Case: boundary
# Coverage: boundary (zero sample angle, (001) cut)
M=np.array([[0.2,0.6,-0.3],[-0.7,0.1,0.4],[0.3,-0.5,0.8]])
assert np.allclose(evaluate_rotated_cmoke_cubic_response(M,0.7,-0.12,'001',0.0), target)

# Case: boundary
# Coverage: boundary (zero sample angle, (111) cut)
M=np.array([[0.2,0.6,-0.3],[-0.7,0.1,0.4],[0.3,-0.5,0.8]])
assert np.allclose(evaluate_rotated_cmoke_cubic_response(M,-0.43+0.17j,0.21-0.08j,'111',0.0), target)

# Case: normal
# Coverage: normal (negative sample angle with nonzero M_P)
M=np.array([[0.13,-0.71,0.22],[-0.42,0.33,-0.59],[0.81,0.14,0.07],[0.28,-0.19,0.63]])
assert np.allclose(evaluate_rotated_cmoke_cubic_response(M,0.19-0.44j,-0.31+0.09j,'111',-0.41), target)

# Case: boundary
# Coverage: boundary (zero sample angle, (001) cut)
M=np.array([[0.2,0.6,-0.3],[-0.7,0.1,0.4],[0.3,-0.5,0.8]])
assert np.allclose(evaluate_rotated_qmoke_quadratic_response(M,0.7,-0.12,'001',0.0), target)

# Case: boundary
# Coverage: boundary (zero sample angle, (111) cut)
M=np.array([[0.2,0.6,-0.3],[-0.7,0.1,0.4],[0.3,-0.5,0.8]])
assert np.allclose(evaluate_rotated_qmoke_quadratic_response(M,-0.43+0.17j,0.21-0.08j,'111',0.0), target)

# Case: normal
# Coverage: normal (negative sample angle with nonzero M_P)
M=np.array([[0.13,-0.71,0.22],[-0.42,0.33,-0.59],[0.81,0.14,0.07],[0.28,-0.19,0.63]])
assert np.allclose(evaluate_rotated_qmoke_quadratic_response(M,0.19-0.44j,-0.31+0.09j,'111',-0.41), target)

# Case: boundary
# Coverage: boundary (one all-zero packet row)
M=np.zeros((1,3),dtype=float)
q=np.zeros((1,6,2),dtype=float)
c=np.zeros((1,6,2),dtype=float)
assert np.allclose(pack_magnetooptic_orders(M,0j,q,c), target)

# Case: boundary
# Coverage: boundary (zero order packet and coefficients)
o=np.zeros((1,3,6,2),dtype=float)
assert np.allclose(compute_third_order_kerr_angles(o,1+0j,0j,0j,0j,0j), target)

# Case: normal
assert np.allclose(build_eight_directional_design(np.array([-0.4,0.2,1.1])), target)

# Case: boundary
# Coverage: boundary (single zero sample angle)
assert np.allclose(build_eight_directional_design(np.array([0.0])), target)

# Case: edge
# Coverage: edge (duplicate unwrapped sample angles)
assert np.allclose(build_eight_directional_design(np.array([2*np.pi,-2*np.pi,2*np.pi])), target)

# Case: normal
x=np.sin(np.arange(5*8*2*2,dtype=float).reshape(5,8,2,2)/9)
assert np.allclose(separate_eight_directional_channels(x), target)

# Case: boundary
# Coverage: boundary (one all-zero scan row)
x=np.zeros((1,8,2,2),dtype=float)
assert np.allclose(separate_eight_directional_channels(x), target)

# Case: edge
# Coverage: edge (sparse signed scan)
x=np.zeros((2,8,2,2),dtype=float)
x[0,7,1,1]=-3.25
x[1,0,0,0]=4.5
assert np.allclose(separate_eight_directional_channels(x), target)

# Case: edge
# Coverage: edge (small magneto-optic coefficients)
assert np.allclose(compute_cmoke_crystal_advantage(-7.2+11.5j,.021e-8-.018e-8j,.027e-8+.006e-8j,.003e-8-.014e-8j,-.005e-8+.003e-8j,.0014e-8+.0009e-8j,.64+.11j,-.09+.04j,-.52-.13j,.14+.08j,36), target)

# Case: boundary
# Coverage: boundary (exactly zero cubic numerators for both cuts)
assert np.allclose(compute_cmoke_crystal_advantage(-9.6+14.2j,0j,.018-.011j,-.007+.016j,0j,0j,.73-.18j,.11+.06j,-.61+.27j,.16-.09j,24), target)

# Case: edge
# Coverage: edge (sub-tolerance cubic numerators for both cuts)
assert np.allclose(compute_cmoke_crystal_advantage(-9.6+14.2j,0j,.018-.011j,-.007+.016j,1e-300+0j,0j,.73-.18j,.11+.06j,-.61+.27j,.16-.09j,48), target)
